
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/aqi00/p/21614119" title="发布于 2026-07-18 11:07">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">15天学会AI应用开发（十四）搭建LangChain的开发环境</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></span>LangChain 是一套大语言模型 (LLM) 应用开发框架，主打链式编排、任务流程组装，可快速搭建智能对话机器人、智能助手、自动化流程、知识库问答、Agent 智能体。
<p>LangChain 支持对接各类在线大模型，包括OpenAI、文心、通义、讯飞等，也支持加载电脑本地的离线大模型。为避免在线大模型带来的大量Token消耗，接下来以离线大模型为例介绍如何搭建LangChain的开发环境。</p>
<h1>一、安装Ollama</h1>
<p>AI应用在加载离线大模型时用到了 Ollama ，它的安装包比较大，有1.8G左右，AI应用的智能体开发必须安装Ollama。<br>
Ollama的下载页面为 https://ollama.com/download ，但外网速度较慢下载很耗时，建议访问博主提供的下载链接 https://www.alipan.com/s/gkea9rqEDTU 。</p>
<p>下载回来的Ollama安装包叫做OllamaSetup.exe，双击它即可安装至系统盘的默认目录。若想修改Ollama的安装路径，就要打开命令行，输入下面的安装命令（以安装到E盘为例）：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="8" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22OllamaSetup.exe%20%2FDIR%3D%5C%22E%3A%5C%5CProgram%20Files%5C%5COllama%5C%22%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">OllamaSetup.exe /DIR="E:\Program Files\Ollama"</code></pre>
</div>
<p>等待安装完毕，在安装目录下会找到“ollama app.exe”和“ollama.exe”两个程序，前者提供了可视化界面，而后者用于命令行，AI应用开发主要使用后者。</p>
<p>另外，需确保系统的PATH环境变量中能找到Ollama的安装目录，例如“E:\Program Files\Ollama”。如果PATH环境变量不包含Ollama的安装目录，则需手工添加该目录。</p>
<h1>二、下载离线大模型</h1>
<p>通过Ollama可以很方便地下载离线大模型，比如在命令行窗口执行下面命令，即可下载大模型qwen2:1.5b：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="7" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22ollama%20pull%20qwen2%3A1.5b%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">ollama pull qwen2:1.5b</code></pre>
</div>
<p>不过下载回来的离线大模型默认放在系统盘的“C:\Users\你的用户名\.ollama\models”目录下，若想修改大模型的保存目录，就要新建名叫OLLAMA_MODELS的环境变量，并将变量值设为指定路径，例如“F:\ollama_models”，那么后续下载的大模型都会保存到新目录下。</p>
<p>等待大模型下载完毕，在命令行窗口执行下面命令，即可启动Ollama并加载大模型：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="6" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22ollama%20serve%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">ollama serve</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后启动浏览器打开链接“http://localhost:11434/api/tags”，观察是否返回json串，有返回表示启动成功。<br>
比如下面返回的json串表示Ollama已加载大模型qwen2:1.5b：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="5" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%7B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22models%5C%22%3A%20%5B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22name%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22qwen2%3A1.5b%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22model%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22qwen2%3A1.5b%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22modified_at%5C%22%3A%20%5C%222026-05-03T17%3A29%3A06.9028074%2B08%3A00%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22size%5C%22%3A%20934964102%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22digest%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22f6daf2b25194025ae2d5288f2afd041997ce48116807a3b612c1a96b09bec03a%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22details%5C%22%3A%20%7B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22parent_model%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22format%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22gguf%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22family%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22qwen2%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22families%5C%22%3A%20%5B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22qwen2%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5D%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22parameter_size%5C%22%3A%20%5C%221.5B%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22quantization_level%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22Q4_0%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5D%5Cn%7D%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">{
&nbsp; &nbsp; "models": [
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {

<h1>三、安装LangChain</h1>
<p>在命令行窗口执行下面命令，即可安装LangChain及其用到的Ollama插件：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="4" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20langchain%20langchain-core%20langchain-ollama%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install langchain langchain-core langchain-ollama</code></pre>
</div>
<p>在命令行窗口执行下面命令，可查看当前三个LangChain的安装版本，建议三个版本都不低于1.0：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="3" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20show%20langchain%5Cnpip%20show%20langchain-core%5Cnpip%20show%20langchain-ollama%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip show langchain
pip show langchain-core
pip show langchain-ollama</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后编写Python测试代码如下，由LangChain调用离线大模型qwen2:1.5b来回答问题：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20langchain_ollama%20import%20OllamaLLM%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BF%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%EF%BC%88Ollama%EF%BC%89%5Cnllm%20%3D%20OllamaLLM(model%3D%5C%22qwen2%3A1.5b%5C%22)%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E6%8F%90%E9%97%AE%5Cnresponse%20%3D%20llm.invoke(%5C%22%E4%BB%8B%E7%BB%8D%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%8B%E4%BA%BA%E5%B7%A5%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%5C%22)%5Cnprint(response)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from langchain_ollama import OllamaLLM

# 连接本地离线大模型（Ollama）
llm = OllamaLLM(model="qwen2:1.5b")

# 提问
response = llm.invoke("介绍一下人工智能")
print(response)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>运行上面的Python代码，输出日志结果如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="1" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%E4%BA%BA%E5%B7%A5%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%EF%BC%88Artificial%20Intelligence%EF%BC%8C%E7%AE%80%E7%A7%B0AI%EF%BC%89%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%80%E7%A7%8D%E6%8A%80%E6%9C%AF%EF%BC%8C%E6%97%A8%E5%9C%A8%E6%9E%84%E5%BB%BA%E8%AE%A1%E7%AE%97%E6%9C%BA%E7%A8%8B%E5%BA%8F%E5%92%8C%E7%B3%BB%E7%BB%9F%E6%9D%A5%E6%A8%A1%E6%8B%9F%E4%BA%BA%E7%B1%BB%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E3%80%82%E8%BF%99%E4%BA%9B%E7%B3%BB%E7%BB%9F%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E5%AD%A6%E4%B9%A0%E3%80%81%E6%8E%A8%E7%90%86%E3%80%81%E6%80%9D%E8%80%83%E3%80%81%E5%88%A4%E6%96%AD%E3%80%81%E8%A7%A3%E5%86%B3%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%E5%92%8C%E8%87%AA%E6%88%91%E4%BC%98%E5%8C%96%EF%BC%8C%E5%B9%B6%E4%B8%94%E8%83%BD%E5%A4%9F%E5%AE%8C%E6%88%90%E5%A4%8D%E6%9D%82%E7%9A%84%E4%BB%BB%E5%8A%A1%EF%BC%8C%E5%A6%82%E8%AF%AD%E9%9F%B3%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB%E3%80%81%E5%9B%BE%E5%83%8F%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E3%80%81%E8%87%AA%E7%84%B6%E8%AF%AD%E8%A8%80%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E7%AD%89%E3%80%82%E4%BA%BA%E5%B7%A5%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E7%9A%84%E7%A0%94%E7%A9%B6%E9%A2%86%E5%9F%9F%E5%8C%85%E6%8B%AC%E6%9C%BA%E5%99%A8%E5%AD%A6%E4%B9%A0%E3%80%81%E6%B7%B1%E5%BA%A6%E5%AD%A6%E4%B9%A0%E3%80%81%E5%BC%BA%E5%8C%96%E5%AD%A6%E4%B9%A0%E5%92%8C%E8%AE%A4%E7%9F%A5%E7%A7%91%E5%AD%A6%E7%AD%89%E3%80%82%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">人工智能（Artificial Intelligence，简称AI）是一种技术，旨在构建计算机程序和系统来模拟人类智能。这些系统可以学习、推理、思考、判断、解决问题和自我优化，并且能够完成复杂的任务，如语音识别、图像处理、自然语言处理等。人工智能的研究领域包括机器学习、深度学习、强化学习和认知科学等。</code></pre>
</div>
<p>可见大模型正常输出回答内容，即介绍了人工智能的概念及其应用领域，正确执行的问答结果说明LangChain已经成功安装。</p>
<p>本系列的AI应用开发文章目录为《<span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="0" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">15天学会AI应用开发全目录（零基础小白，零Token消耗）》。</span>​</p>
